## Problem and behavior

Describe the problem and what changes for the user.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests and `go vet ./...` pass.
- [ ] Go sources are formatted.
- [ ] Public CLI remains pull-only and protects local changes.
- [ ] Documentation matches the change.
- [ ] No credentials, personal logs, binaries or release archives are included.

For TUI changes, include terminal dimensions and a screenshot when useful.
